author: Mirco
name: xLSTM mLSTM (pure MLX)
blurb: xLSTM experiment: replaces transformer self-attention with mLSTM (matrix LSTM, Beck et al. 2024) implemented in pure MLX. 6 mLSTM blocks at dim=512, 4 heads, SiLU-gated FFN. Uses parallel form (materialized S×S gating matrix) for training. Not yet trained — code-only snapshot for experimentation.
